type T = Uppercase<number>;
type U<T> = Lowercase<T>;
type V<T extends string> = Capitalize<T>;
type W = Uncapitalize<"a" | 1>;
type X = Uppercase<any>;
type Y = Uppercase<never>;
type Z<T extends `a${string}`> = Uppercase<T>;
type Z2 = Lowercase<string>;
type Z3 = Lowercase<unknown>;
type Z4<T extends "a" | "b"> = Lowercase<T>;
console.log(1);
